statistical_comparison.scientific_conclusion: Under the matched budget of 20 trials, both search strategies achieved comparable generalization performance across 3 independent holdout test replicates (mean test delta: +0.0182 f1_weighted).
statistical_comparison.uncertainty_limitations: Experimental findings are based on N=3 seed replicates with matched partitions. Small sample sizes limit inferential statistical power (df={n-1}). Apparent advantages in sample means must be treated as exploratory evidence rather than a confirmatory proof of asymptotic superiority. Search performance depends heavily on the dimensionality and structure of the hyperparameter space.
